note: Same shape as qwen3.5-0.8b: 18 Gated-DeltaNet layers (symmetric key/value heads) + 6 full-attention layers. Only hidden (2048) and intermediate (6144) size scale up. NOT an official OE-LLM architecture; BLLM-native only. The vision half of the checkpoint is dropped for the text package (see the qwen3.5-vlm recipe for image+text).

quantisation.kept_fp32: SSM recurrence, depthwise conv, RMSNorms, GDN gated-norm
quantisation.note: Same data-free quantisation as qwen3.5-0.8b — flat int16 activation ranges fit at this size with no calibration set. (4B needs per-linear activation calibration; see the qwen3.5-4b recipe.)

variants.name: qwen3.5-2b-ctx4k-int8-s100
variants.prefill: chunked-float-N32; attention rewritten this release to GQA batched matmul (query grouped by kv-head, kv stays at NKV heads throughout) instead of expand_win broadcast, plus mask deduplication (causal mask is head-independent: [1,CL] broadcast, not [NHa,CL] duplicated) — both ported down from qwen3.5-0.8b's recipe.

toolchain.note: Recorded so a future regression can be attributed. Host toolchain and board HBRT must match.

measured.note: Re-measured S100P, 2026-07-29, performance mode set, against the current GQA+mask-dedup build (common/bench_vlm.py, 3 repeated chat() runs with a real image, temp=0). decode_tok_s essentially unchanged from the pre-rewrite baseline (13.20 vs 13.22) — consistent with the board output being verified bit-identical to that baseline. bpu_graph_ms/effective_weight_bandwidth_GBps are NOT independently re-measured this pass (no hrt_model_exec run) — left at their pre-rewrite values since decode_tok_s confirms no change.

ppl.measured: S100P, 2026-07-29, common/eval_ppl.py against the GQA+mask-dedup build

task_metric.name: coherence-anchors + prefill/decode parity + image contrast
task_metric.protocol: common/eval_parity.py (prefill vs no-prefill, text-mode session on the same .hbm) — first-token match, 48-token greedy identical, control-ppl identical; with-image vs without-image contrast on a real photo (two brown bears), temp=0; EN factual, ZH factual, arithmetic; multi-turn name recall
task_metric.measured: pass — parity PASS (S100P, 2026-07-29); image contrast PASS (correctly describes the photo with image, correctly declines without); EN/ZH/arithmetic anchors PASS; multi-turn memory correct (verified via the model's own visible reasoning trace — the final answer was cut off by the test harness's token budget when Qwen3.5's thinking mode ran long, a test-harness limit, not a model failure; NativeVlmSession currently has no set_thinking() to force a direct answer the way the text-only NativeSession does)

variants.name: qwen3.5-2b-ctx512-int8-s100
variants.prefill: chunked-float-N32, same GQA batched-matmul + mask-dedup rewrite as the ctx4k variant above

measured.note: S100P, 2026-07-29, performance mode set (common/bench_vlm.py, 3 repeated chat() runs with a real image, temp=0).

task_metric.name: coherence-anchors + prefill/decode parity + image contrast
task_metric.measured: pass — parity PASS, image contrast PASS, EN/ZH/arithmetic PASS, multi-turn memory correct (same thinking-mode-truncation caveat as ctx4k)

rejected_builds.name: block_quantized_matmul (dynamic-quant decode)
rejected_builds.why: Same failure as qwen3.5-0.8b: the dynamic per-token quant path is a PREFILL op, ~130x slower per matmul in decode than the static leap.linear path. Not independently re-measured at this size — the mechanism does not depend on model size.

rejected_builds.name: all-BPU chunked prefill (Newton triangular inverse)
rejected_builds.why: Same numerical failure as qwen3.5-0.8b: Newton doubling's 2I-AX transiently overshoots and int16 clips it on deep layers. Not size-dependent — see that recipe for the measured cosine collapse.

board_verification.flow: stop resident serving processes; run common/eval_parity.py + common/eval_ppl.py against a text-mode view of the package (same model.hbm/model_prefill.hbm, model.json with the visual key dropped — the decoder graph is unchanged by adding vision, see qwen3.5-vlm recipe); run image-contrast + task-coherence anchors through the actual NativeVlmSession; benchmark decode_tok_s/ttft_ms via common/bench_vlm.py; restore the stopped processes
